title: MakerCoachResult
description: Final co-creation output contract emitted by lumei-human-ai-operational-maker-coach, feeding back into the STAR learning loop.

artifact_type.description: Category of artifact produced (e.g. prompt_workflow, operational_checklist, triage_template, decision_rubric).

draft_artifact.description: The draft prototype content produced. Marked explicitly as DRAFT / PROVISIONAL.

evidence_used.description: Authorized data sources or facts used in creating the artifact.

assumptions_remaining.description: Assumptions that still require frontline validation.

verification_status.description: Provenance state tracking human validation. Never self-certified by the model.

risks_and_boundary_conditions.description: Known risks, operational edge cases, and non-applicable contexts.

next_safe_action.description: Smallest observable, reversible real-world test of the draft artifact.

evidence_to_collect.description: Signals to capture during testing (e.g. error rate, user clarity, edge case discovery, time saved).

learning_note.description: Concise After-Action reflection note connecting the prototype experience back to the employee's IDP or STAR episode.
